text:
mira: Heads-up: HealthCorp POC — intermittent missing trace_id in logs (mostly worker/backfill tasks) and occasional 429s hitting their Sysdig collector. Need quick triage before tomorrow's executive demo.

sam: On it. Confirming: they're using our HTTP log-drain, right? Or Console forwarder?

mira: HTTP drain -> Sysdig. Missing trace_ids correlate to batch workers spawned by cron. 429s appear during bursts when they reingest older data. Also asked about stripping PII before export.

alex: Typical root cause: trace header not propagated into job payload. Quick fix: attach x-redwood-trace when enqueueing and call redwood.context.propagate() at worker start. Example (python):
# enqueue
trace = request.headers.get('x-redwood-trace')
enqueue(job_payload, headers={'x-redwood-trace': trace})
# worker startup
from redwood import context
context.propagate(received_headers.get('x-redwood-trace'))
Then worker logs will include trace_id.

jen: I can open live-tail for them during the session. Share a unique token we can search for.

alex: I'll temporarily raise their drain quota for the demo window. Also 429s could be on Sysdig side; options: increase Sysdig quota, enable client-side buffering, or we can allow higher drain rate for the POC. I'll bump for 2h and monitor.

carl: For PII we have export transforms. Console -> Exports -> Transformations supports field removal and regex redaction. Example YAML they can apply: - remove_field: ssn  - redact_regex: pattern: "(?i)password\\s*[:=]\\s*\\S+" replace_with: "[REDACTED]"

mira: Can we run an 11:00am PT troubleshooting session? Need someone from SE + SRE to watch live-tail, run a burst test, and validate redaction config.

sam: I can lead the call. Alex please bump quota now so we don't hit 429s during verification.

alex: Done. Bumped `hc-poc` drain 150->400 req/s for 2h. ingest-bot: Quota change logged at 1959991400 UTC.
ingest-bot: Quota update applied: `hc-poc` drain_rate 150->400 req/s by alex at 1959991400 UTC.

alex: Send them this quick reproducible curl to create a trace we can find in live-tail: curl -s -H "x-redwood-trace: HC-DBG-$(date +%s)" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping"}' ; then filter live-tail for HC-DBG-.

sam: I'll also prepare a short checklist in the shared drive: [1] verify trace appears end-to-end, [2] run 200 req burst, [3] confirm zero 429s during window, [4] apply export transform and validate PII removed.

mira: Great. Scheduling 11:00am PT and inviting HealthCorp security. After the walkthrough we'll confirm and close. If issues persist we'll escalate to eng-oncall.
